In summary, our research is concerned with
the genetic architecture of a novel immune gene, APL, which is required for the Rel1-dependent host response to malaria parasite infection.
the identification of genes and gene families that are important for the immune response in the mosquito, and the genetic architecture of the mosquito immune response to malaria parasites.
the molecular basis of mosquito immunity to malaria parasites, and the genetic variation that underlies the ability to resist or succumb to infection.
